title: "Lecture 10 Team Projects"
subtitle: "Credit Spread Exposure and Credit Risk Modeling"
---

## Project 1: Spread Duration and Credit Scenario Budget

**Scenario.** Determine how much spread widening would erase one year of portfolio carry.

**Objectives.** Estimate carry and spread duration; calculate break-even widening; distinguish spread, default, Treasury-rate, and liquidity risk.

**Sources.** Bond trades from the [FINRA Trade Reporting and Compliance Engine (TRACE)](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/fixed-income), issuer filings from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/), option-adjusted spread (OAS) indexes from [Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/32241), and [U.S. Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView) yields. If position analytics are unavailable, use the documented [Lecture 10 fallback credit-risk snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-10-credit.csv).

**Deliverables.** Position profile, calculations, break-even result, three scenarios, risk-budget recommendation, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Inputs 20; calculations 30; scenarios 20; decomposition and recommendation 20; presentation 10.

## Project 2: Expected Loss and Bondholder Recovery

**Scenario.** Compare two speculative-grade bonds with different default probabilities, seniority, collateral, and prices.

**Objectives.** Estimate expected loss; analyze recovery drivers; compare expected loss with observed spread while recognizing risk and liquidity premiums.

**Sources.** Issuer filings from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/), bond observations from [FINRA](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/fixed-income), public rating-agency default and recovery studies, and high-yield spreads from [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/BAMLH0A0HYM2). If aligned inputs are unavailable, use the documented probability-of-default and recovery assumptions in the [Lecture 10 fallback credit-risk snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-10-credit.csv).

**Deliverables.** Capital structure, PD/recovery assumptions, loss scenarios, spread comparison, creditor preference, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Research 20; loss calculations 25; recovery reasoning 25; judgment 20; presentation and citations 10.

## Project 3: Rating Migration Stress Test

**Scenario.** Estimate the effect of a recession-driven wave of downgrades on an investment-grade portfolio.

**Objectives.** Map holdings to rating buckets; apply a transition matrix; translate migrations into spread shocks and value changes; identify fallen-angel risk.

**Sources.** Public rating-agency transition studies, exchange-traded fund (ETF) holdings, and spread indexes from [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/32241). If a usable portfolio or transition matrix is unavailable, use the documented holdings, transition probabilities, and rating-spread shocks in the [Lecture 10 fallback credit-risk snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-10-credit.csv).

**Deliverables.** Starting profile, migration matrix, base and recession losses, concentration findings, action plan, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Portfolio mapping 20; migration analysis 25; valuation effects 25; action plan 20; presentation and reproducibility 10.

## Project 4: Covenant and Capital-Structure Relative Value

**Scenario.** Choose between two bonds from one issuer that differ in seniority, security, covenants, maturity, and spread.

**Objectives.** Build a waterfall; compare covenant protection; estimate recovery ranges; decide whether incremental spread compensates for structural subordination.

**Sources.** Issuer filings and prospectuses from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/), bond observations from [FINRA](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/fixed-income), and public rating-agency recovery studies. If a complete capital structure is unavailable, use the documented debt claims, covenants, and enterprise-value scenarios in the [Lecture 10 fallback credit-risk snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-10-credit.csv).

**Deliverables.** Capital-structure diagram, covenant comparison, recovery waterfall, spread-versus-risk conclusion, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Document research 25; waterfall 25; covenant and recovery reasoning 25; recommendation 15; presentation and sourcing 10.
